name: Lunge with Twist
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold your arms extended in front of your chest or hands clasped together.
Step forward into a lunge with one leg, bending both knees until your front thigh is roughly parallel to the floor.
Brace your core and rotate your upper torso smoothly toward the side of your front leg while keeping your hips square.
Rotate back to center, push off your front foot to return to standing, and alternate legs on each repetition.
tips: Twist through your upper back and obliques rather than letting your front knee wobble side to side.
Maintain an upright spine instead of leaning forward over your front thigh.
